text:
liya: quick share — ran A100 vs H100 microbench across us-west / us-east / eu-west for vicuna-7b, llama2-7b, mpt-7b. Prefill + decode, seq=2048, burst pattern (1-8 concurrent streams). TL;DR: H100 wins decode latency & p95, A100 edges on $/1M tokens in a few configs because of instance/cost diffs + kernel selection oddities. details below.

ben: nice. can you paste tokens/sec and $/1M for vicuna? single-stream or burst?

liya: single-stream with microburst profile. vicuna-7b @2048: H100 decode ~= 4200 tokens/sec, A100 decode ~= 3300 tokens/sec. prefill p50: H100 48ms, A100 68ms. cost / 1M tokens (cloud only): H100 ~$7.8, A100 ~$6.1 (see note on kernel fallthrough).

eva: wait cheaper but slower — was the A100 falling back to a generic kernel? which quant/kernel combos did you test?

liya: yes — runtime picked optimized q4_0 kernels on H100. on A100 some layers didn't have a specialized q4_0 path so they fell back to the generic matmul kernel -> higher latency. tested q4_0, q4_1, fp16. command used:

```bash
run_bench --model vicuna-7b --seq 2048 --gpu h100 --quant q4_0 --mode prefill-decode --region us-west --runs 5
run_bench --model vicuna-7b --seq 2048 --gpu a100 --quant q4_0 --mode prefill-decode --region us-west --runs 5
```

raj: what about region topology? NVLink vs PCIe made a difference?

liya: yes — us-east (NVLink config) showed better prefill throughput for H100: prefill tokens/sec H100 us-east ~= 5100 vs us-west 4200. eu-west hosts had older PCIe gen so ~10-15% worse prefill. decode latency less sensitive but p99 widened in eu-west.

maya: can you drop p95/p99 numbers? need for SLO sizing.

liya: sure — p95 decode: H100 92ms, A100 160ms. p99 decode (burst 8 streams): H100 180ms, A100 310ms. prefill p95: H100 120ms, A100 220ms in worst hosts.

ben: interesting. how does quantization affect cost estimate? q4_0 vs q4_1?

liya: q4_0 gave best token/sec on H100 (specialized kernels), q4_1 slightly slower but more stable across architectures. A100 had fewer optimized q4_0 kernels so q4_1 sometimes beat q4_0 on A100 due to less fallback. cost delta ~10-18% between q4_0 and q4_1 depending on chosen instance pricing and throughput.

eva: any surprising kernel fallthrough examples (layer types)?

liya: small heads + rotary embeddings layers fell back on A100 for q4_0 in Vicuna patch; runtime logs show: "no optimized_q4_0_kernel for matmul_shape (2048, 256) -> using generic". will attach logs.

perf-bot: artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/2060001122/bench-summary.csv, /artifacts/2060001122/kernel-selection.log, /traces/2060001122/trace-1.zip

liya: next steps I propose: (1) run 95th/99th focused runs with more seeds in eu-west/us-east, (2) capture kernel selection and layer-level latency heatmap, (3) open runtime issue to prioritize adding the missing q4_0 kernels for A100 shapes that hit the fallback. @ben @eva can you take (2) and (3)?

ben: I can take (3) — will create runtime issue with reproducer and attach kernel-selection.log

eva: I'll do (2) — will run heatmap + p99 traces next run and post results.

liya: perfect. one more note: for capacity sizing, use H100 for latency-sensitive SLOs (p95 < 100ms) and A100 for cost-sensitive bulk embedding workloads. for mixed workloads consider routing policy by model+route: low-latency -> H100, best-effort -> A100.

raj: awesome, thanks for the quick sweep. saved the artifacts.

liya: thanks — will post a short doc with numbers and a chart embed after the next run. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
